calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.calendar_year,
  d.calendar_month,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS sales_including_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year, d.calendar_month
ORDER BY d.calendar_year, d.calendar_month

SELECT 
  d.calendar_month,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipt_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS store_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY d.calendar_month
ORDER BY d.calendar_month

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  fully_loaded,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  d.calendar_month,
  MIN(d.calendar_date) AS month_start,
  MAX(d.calendar_date) AS month_end
FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, d.calendar_month
ORDER BY d.calendar_month

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  fully_loaded,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period IN (4, 5, 6)

SELECT 
  d.calendar_month,
  f.channel_code,
  c.channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount), 2) AS sales_including_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_channel c ON f.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY d.calendar_month, f.channel_code, c.channel_name
ORDER BY d.calendar_month, f.channel_code

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  MIN(business_date) AS start_date,
  MAX(business_date) AS end_date
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9)

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(net_sales_before_returns), 2) AS net_sales_before_returns_ex_vat
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM business_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM business_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  net_amount,
  vat_rate,
  gross_amount,
  ROUND(net_amount * (1 + vat_rate), 2) AS calculated_gross,
  ROUND(gross_amount - net_amount, 2) AS vat_amount
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sale_date) = 2024
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) = 8
LIMIT 10
